## Fitpal PROD — Reconcile

3rd gate of payment reconciliation, against **orders.fitpal.gr** (production).

**This runs ALONGSIDE Netlify's own `*/5` cron — on purpose.**
Measured 2026-09-03: Netlify cron fires on prod, but skipped 70 times in 48h, worst gap 25.1 min. This workflow covers those holes.

Safe to double-fire: `viva-reconcile` is idempotent — `markPaid` is a guarded `UPDATE ... WHERE payment_status='pending'`, so two triggers produce exactly one row change.

⚠️ **Do not edit this workflow casually.** A manual edit of the DEV twin left `viva-reconcile` untriggered for 17 days (23 Jun – 10 Jul 2026, found in WEC-532). If you change it, verify afterwards:

```sql
select provider, max(run_at), now() - max(run_at) as age
from reconcile_runs group by provider;
```

Linear: WEC-534 (scheduler cutover) · WEC-646 (liveness alerting — still missing, nothing shouts if BOTH triggers die)

DEV twin: «Fitpal DEV — Reconcile (every 15 min)», id `QZ52tBjmt9q8kP5u` — leave it alone.
